image.headline:
MTS & Junior Engineer
1,260 Posts · 10th Pass Eligible

intro: Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released Advertisement No. 06/2026 for 1,260 posts of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) and Junior Engineer (Electrical). The MTS posts are open to 10th pass candidates, which makes this one of the biggest Delhi government job opportunities for matriculates this year.

Online applications are being accepted on the DSSSB OARS portal from 12 November 2026 to 11 December 2026. Read the eligibility, age limit, category-wise fee and selection process below before applying.
table: MTS: 10th Pass · JE: Diploma/Degree in Electrical Engineering
Multi Tasking Staff (MTS – incl. MTS Aaya & MTS General Duty)
after: The vacancies are tentative. Department-wise and category-wise (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS) distribution is given in the official advertisement.

ul: Junior Engineer (Electrical): Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution.
Post-wise additional requirements (if any) are mentioned in the advertisement.

p: Age is calculated as on the closing date, 11 December 2026. Upper age relaxation as per Government of NCT of Delhi rules:
after: For NDMC Junior Engineer (Electrical) the upper age limit is reported as 32 years. Check post-wise age limits in the official advertisement.
Fee is payable online through SBI e-pay (Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI).

ul: Computer Based Test (CBT) as per the scheme of examination in the advertisement

sections.h: How to Apply for DSSSB MTS & JE 2026
ol: Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not done already.
Log in and select Advertisement No. 06/2026 and your post.
Fill in the form, upload photo and signature.
Pay the fee (if applicable) and submit.
Download and keep the confirmation page.

faq: How many posts are there in DSSSB Advt 06/2026?
There are 1,260 posts: 1,075 Multi Tasking Staff and 185 Junior Engineer (Electrical).
What is the last date for DSSSB MTS 2026?
The last date to apply online is 11 December 2026.
Can 10th pass apply for DSSSB MTS 2026?
Yes. The minimum qualification for MTS posts is 10th pass.
What is the DSSSB MTS age limit?
18 to 27 years as on 11 December 2026, with 3 years relaxation for OBC (Delhi), 5 years for SC/ST and 10 years for PwBD.
What is the application fee for DSSSB 2026?
₹100 for General, OBC and EWS. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen do not pay any fee.
Where to apply for DSSSB MTS and JE 2026?
final: DSSSB Recruitment 2026 under Advt 06/2026 is a great chance for 10th pass candidates and electrical engineers to get a Delhi government job. Apply before 11 December 2026 and keep checking for the exam date.
Follow @employmentjunction.in on Instagram for instant updates on the DSSSB admit card and result.
schema_description:
DSSSB has notified 1,260 posts (Advt 06/2026): 1,075 Multi Tasking Staff and 185 Junior Engineer (Electrical).

Eligibility: MTS – 10th pass; JE – Diploma/Degree in Electrical Engineering. Age 18–27 years as on 11.12.2026 (NDMC JE up to 32), relaxation 3 yrs OBC (Delhi), 5 yrs SC/ST, 10 yrs PwBD.

Fee: Rs 100 for General/OBC/EWS; nil for women, SC, ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen.

Selection: Computer Based Test and document verification.

Dates: Apply online 12 November – 11 December 2026 at dsssbonline.nic.in.
